problems.title: The selected margin disables the negative-pair term
problems.source_location: Section 2.5, PDF pp.6–7, Eqs.(24)–(28); Section 3.1 parameter setting
claim: Section 2.5 defines cosine similarities \(S_{ij}\) of normalized nonzero embeddings and negative loss proportional to \(\max(0,S_{ij}-\xi)\). Sections 3.1 and 3.5 select \(\xi=1\).
analysis: Cauchy–Schwarz gives \(S_{ij}\leq1\), so every negative hinge is zero whenever \(\xi\geq1\). Collapsed same-direction embeddings and an orthogonal two-class construction can both attain zero for this pairwise subobjective. Thus the selected setting cannot supply the stated negative-pair repulsion.
result: The negative component is inactive as written. This does not establish collapse of an unknown complete training objective or refute the retrieval measurements.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
repair: A margin \(m<1\) restores a nonempty active region \(S_{ij}>m\). At \(m=0\), two collapsed negative pairs contribute \(2\), while orthogonal negatives contribute \(0\). This only repairs the hinge’s active region.
problems.impact_rationale: The demonstrated defect is a component-level degeneracy; the full method’s outcome remains unverified.
problems.existing_correction_status: An explicit local correction is described; author adoption and a corresponding published erratum are not established.

problems.title: The loss-to-hash-parameter connection is underspecified
problems.source_location: Section 2.4, PDF pp.5–6, Eqs.(13)–(23); Section 2.5 loss inputs
claim: Equations (13)–(23) introduce auxiliary channel weights and hash-probability parameters, whereas Section 2.5 names the earlier mapped features as the loss inputs.
analysis: Under the literal upstream-feature reading, the loss does not depend on the separate downstream parameters, and their partial derivatives are zero. If the feature notation instead denotes downstream outputs, or another loss is used, that conclusion need not hold. The implementation needed to choose between these readings is unavailable.
result: Whether the actual auxiliary and hash parameters receive training gradients requires additional evidence.
assumptions: Only the cited paper version and explicitly described mathematical or implementation conditions are assessed.
repair: Specify the actual loss inputs, trainable parameter groups and computational graph. No replacement objective or claim that the authors left parameters untrained is established.
problems.impact_rationale: The operative training graph is uncertain; a supported implementation failure cannot be inferred from ambiguous notation.
problems.existing_correction_status: An explicit local correction is described; author adoption and a corresponding published erratum are not established.
